YOUR DETAILS

Privacy &
your enquiry.

This page explains how the enquiry tools on this website work.

When you prepare an enquiry

The enquiry form prepares a message in your browser. It does not send your details to Spotless Vibes or save them in a website database. Please avoid including sensitive information such as access codes in your initial enquiry.

When you choose WhatsApp or email

The details you enter are added to a draft in your chosen messaging service. You decide when to send it. WhatsApp and your email provider handle information under their own terms and privacy policies.

What your message is used for

Information you send to Spotless Vibes is used to respond to your enquiry and discuss or arrange the requested service. Contact the business directly if you have questions about your messages or want to ask for information to be corrected or removed.

Website operation

This website does not add advertising trackers or analytics tools. The hosting service may process technical information needed to deliver and secure the website. Fonts are served with the website.

Get in touch

Email Spotlessvibes@yahoo.com or call +44 7881 655298 with questions about your enquiry.
